title: •_Stalker_
caption: •_Stalker_ (V)
game_text: May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 2 vehicles and 4 TIEs. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. During your deploy phase, may ▼ one {icon:virtual-set symbol} Probe Droid to a related site.
lore: Originally assigned to search the Outer Rim for new worlds to subjugate. Launched the probe droid that found Echo Base. Later reassigned to Death Squadron.
copyright: TM & © 1996 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1996 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique (•). 'Stalker' is italic in the slip's title line and caption, 'Imperial' italic in the CAPITAL banner — marked _…_ in title/caption/card_type as on vs2/36. Stats POWER 8 / ARMOR 7 / HYPERSPEED 3; slip deploy 8 / forfeit 9 (same as printed). Scomp-link ring at the top-left of the text box → scomp true. Icon column top to bottom: yellow square with black pilot helmet → 'permanent-pilot', red square with green nav-computer dome → 'nav'. Inline grey sphere before 'Probe Droid' (the sheet's virtual-card symbol, as on vs4/40 and vs2/32) → {icon:virtual-set symbol}. Lore matches the scan (confirmed on the 745 px V1 remake, which keeps the printed lore). Base scan only 348×488 (Hoth-D-stalker.gif, the only Decipher face on the wiki). Modern: V1-D-stalker.gif (745, Virtual Set 1 — different game text) used; VB2 -pre and non-pre (350, identical bytes) also downloaded. Copyright 1996 (Hoth), not legible at 348 px; legible on the V1 remake.
